name: PdxCascader
description:
A multi-level drill-down selector: each choice opens the next column of children, as in Country,
then Region, then City.
generics: T extends { value: string; label: string }

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name (aria-label) for the trigger; falls back to placeholder

members.name: size
members.description: xs, sm, md (the default), lg or xl — the same scale as pdx-input.

members.name: value
members.description: The path, one option's value per level. A form submits one entry per level under the name (#135).

members.name: getLabels
members.description: The labels of the current path, from the root down.

members.name: toggle
members.description: Open the popup when closed, close it when open.

events.name: open-change
events.description: The popup opened (`true`) or closed (`false`): its open state, read-only, as an overlay's (#287).

events.name: pdx-clear
events.description: Fired when the clear button or `clear()` empties the path, after its `value-change`.

events.name: pdx-load-error
events.description: Fired when `loadChildren` rejects; the branch stays askable and can be clicked again.

events.name: value-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `value`. Does not bubble.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name (aria-label) for the trigger; falls back to placeholder

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: xs, sm, md (the default), lg or xl — the same scale as pdx-input.

slots.name: option
slots.description: Renders one option in a column: a snippet `option(node, level, selected)`.
slots.signature: (node: T | (T extends { children?: readonly (infer C)[] } ? C | (C extends { children?: readonly (infer D)[] } ? D : never) : never), level: number, selected: boolean)

cssParts.name: root
cssParts.description: The trigger, the combobox: the frame, its border and background.

cssParts.name: clear
cssParts.description: The clear button, while `clearable`, something is chosen and not `disabled`.

cssParts.name: popup
cssParts.description: The floating panel that holds the columns, or the search results.

cssParts.name: search
cssParts.description: The search field atop the panel, while `searchable`.

cssParts.name: list
cssParts.description: A column, or the list of search results: a `role="listbox"`.

cssParts.name: option
cssParts.description: An option of a column, or a search result.

cssParts.name: spinner
cssParts.description: The spinner of a branch being fetched by `loadChildren`.

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-border-color
cssProperties.description: The trigger is the text input's frame, `.pdx-input-wrap`, and reads pdx-input's tokens (#761): its border at rest (the outlined input style).

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-border-color-focus
cssProperties.description: The frame's border while focused (the outlined input style).

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-border-width
cssProperties.description: The frame's bottom border, in the filled input style.

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-focus-ring
cssProperties.description: The ring around the frame while focused.

cssProperties.name: --pdx-input-min-height
cssProperties.description: The frame's height, at the md size.

cssStates.name: loading
cssStates.description: A branch's children are being fetched by `loadChildren`.
